name: clock-drifted-ahead
description: Six hours on a 0.85 U/hr profile with boluses from the pump's screen, on a pump whose clock has drifted 7 minutes ahead since it was last set, with no record of it (the drift happened before the window). Every record is stamped 7 minutes ahead and nothing in the log says so: only the pump's clock against the phone's tells, and that is past a 5-minute skew threshold but well inside a 24-hour trust limit. Every bolus should reach the host at the instant it was given.
